title: TerrainProblemRelation
description: An explicit typed edge between a TERRAIN problem and a canonical venture idea. Captures which part of the workflow the idea addresses, what remains, and the strength of the connection.

ideaId.description: References a canonical idea record in data/ideas.json.

relationType.description: ADDRESSES = idea directly targets this problem. PARTIALLY_ADDRESSES = covers some frictions/steps. SHIFTS = idea may move friction to another actor/step. CREATES = idea may introduce a new problem.

workflowCoverage.description: Which specific workflow step IDs the idea would affect. Prevents claiming the idea solves the whole problem when it only touches steps 4-6. §524.

residualProblem.description: What remains unsolved after this idea is applied. §525. Important for honest evaluation.

newProblems.description: Potential new frictions the idea could create. e.g. 'AI automation → new human review requirement'. §526.

reasoning.description: Why we believe this relation holds. Must not just re-state the idea description. Must reference specific problem frictions or workflow steps. §224.

confidence.description: Confidence in this relation, given current evidence level of the underlying problem.
